//: TEMPLATE. Copy this to ~/.orga-ai/config.json and fill in the three values,
which your administrator will send you. Do not put them back into
tools/config.json: that file is distributed publicly.
Why a file and not environment variables: Claude Code runs `orga-login token`
from a non-interactive shell, which does not reliably inherit variables you
export in a terminal. A file works regardless of who launches the process.
Why under ~/.orga-ai and not inside the repository: it cannot be committed by
accident, so it does not depend on a .gitignore being right.
Keys omitted here fall back to tools/config.json, so this file only needs the
three below. Check it with: ./orga-login status
//client_id: Public Cognito app client id for the CLI. No secret attached.
//cognito_domain: Hosted-UI domain of the user pool. Bare host or full URL both accepted.
//gateway_url: Where the token is used. Lets `orga-login status` name the target; not required for sign-in itself.
